I am filing this complaint because American Express continues to report and mischaracterize fraudulent accounts opened in my name. Three unauthorized credit card accounts were opened without my consent. I filed disputes directly with American Express and with the credit bureaus. 

Despite providing an FTC Identity Theft Report ( Report No. XXXX ) and a police report, American Express denied two of the three fraud disputes, claiming that I benefited from the cards because of a XXXX XXXX charge. I have never flown XXXX XXXX in my life. Their proof is inaccurate and does not establish that I authorized or used the accounts. 

All three major credit bureaus ( XXXX XXXX XXXX  ) have since deleted the fraudulent accounts based on my FTC and police reports, which shows that Amexs fraud determination is inconsistent and unsupported. Amex deleted one account but refuses to remove two others, which violates my rights under the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA 605B ) and leaves me vulnerable to re-reporting. 

I am requesting that CFPB compel American Express to : 1. Permanently close and delete all three fraudulent accounts. 
2. Cease sending inaccurate benefited from use denial letters. 
3. Confirm in writing that none of these accounts will be reinserted on my credit reports.

I am filing this complaint against Equifax for failing to correct inaccurate and outdated personal information on my credit report, in violation of the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ). Despite multiple requests, Equifax has retained incorrect versions of my name and addresses where I have never lived, even though I have provided my accurate information.

Violations of the FCRA : Failure to Maintain Accurate Information ( FCRA, Section 609 - 15 U.S.C. 1681g ) Under Section 609 of the FCRA, credit reporting agencies are obligated to maintain only accurate, verifiable consumer information. Equifaxs refusal to remove outdated names and addresses despite verified updates is a violation of this requirement.

Inclusion of Unauthorized Information Equifaxs persistence in reporting unauthorized names and addresses without proper validation violates my rights to accuracy under the FCRA. This unauthorized retention of outdated data, which I have not validated, is not only inaccurate but also potentially harmful to my credit standing.

Impact on My Financial Standing : The presence of incorrect names and outdated addresses on my credit report negatively affects my credit score and overall financial reputation, hindering my ability to access credit and pursue financial opportunities.
